fusions.name: Slurry Slide
fusions.desc: Sends a slide of mud through a cone 4 tiles deep. It deals 13 damage, carries enemies back 2 tiles and has a 50% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Grit in the Current
fusions.desc: Sends a stream of grit at the target in front of you that deals 4 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck Spring
fusions.desc: Cracks the ground at your feet and a spring wells up. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Alluvium
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a layer of silt settles on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per layer (28% at full). Unfed, a layer fades every 10 seconds.
